briefing.headline: Four genuinely new B2B roles landed in the last 48 hours — spend today there, not on the Amazon/Datadog backlog you've already skipped.
briefing.focus: Your highest-leverage 20 minutes: Anthropic's Enterprise Integrated Campaign Manager (posted yesterday, ABM/demand-gen is literally your resume) and AWS Technical PMM for Databases (posted yesterday, Amazon is the single most reliable H-1B sponsor on this list). Then fire off the two quick ones — Webflow's Demand Gen Associate (US-remote, associate level, low competition) and the Amazon MLU Marketing Ops PM that the keyword score badly under-rated at 88. Keep CarGurus B2B Marketing Specialist alive as your only real Boston B2B marketing shot even though it's been sitting for seven runs — a Boston-local application is worth more than a seventh look at a Seattle req.
